_comment: SoA override: original mod jar recipe references invalid 1.12-style camelCase forge tags (forge:ingotEnergium / forge:ingotUUMatter / forge:nuggetPrimordial etc.) that are not valid 1.13+ ResourceLocations and fail parse. Inputs come from absent mods (IC2/IC2Classic, TConEvo addon) so the recipes can never have worked. Wrap in a forge:false condition so the inner stub is never registered, suppressing the parse warning.
